declaration.argument: Expressions and labels are decoded once per program into a form beside the graph and executed in the same order over the same slots: every compiled expression arm mirrors eval's operand order, errors and borrowed-operand events, and every decoded operation performs the matching label arm's effects in the same order, so no RNG draw, id allocation, pc sequence, yield point or container order moves. Call targets resolve to the same FunctionInfo through a table built from the immutable call maps, with the same errors on fallback. The channel table becomes a Vec indexed by channel id, which is dense from 0 per run with no removal; its only iteration is the order-free XOR in State::signature. A differential test runs all 44 Expr variants through both evaluators. One-thread identity runs at a fixed run count on VR, Mencius_opt1_2 and SDPaxos showed 0 differing rows in executions, logs, traces and runs, identical stall_cap_runs.csv hashes, and no pre-existing dump leaf differing except a clock and the disclosed run_buffers.channel_table_grows.
